summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with four tests in TestLoadDecathalonDatalist. Tests were not run and black was not run, per instructions. Line lengths were measured: nothing exceeds 120 columns. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list data_list_key value raises ValueError, and a non-dict top-level JSON document is treated as a missing key. Nothing was committed.
